name: Yoru Chocolate
description: A bold, quiet store theme for a small bean-to-bar chocolatier working at night in a former print shop on Kanzaki-dōri, Hoshikawa City: single-origin bonbons, tablets and gift boxes, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Iron-navy (tetsukon) pages with washi fibres, kinari text, washi-light sections and one full yamabuki-yellow band; Kaisei Decol for display, BIZ UDPGothic for text. English is always set horizontally: the Japanese feel comes from asymmetric columns, hairline spines with big 01/02 numerals and staggered tall pictures; on a Chinese, Japanese or Korean site the titles, menu and captions switch to vertical writing (tategaki). The header (H11) is a top band with the wordmark, an Order a box button, account and cart, and from 1100 px the menu sits in a rail on the right edge as a clean stacked list with hairline rules and a dot on the current page; the home page (L5) opens on a large title beside a tall maki-e lacquer drawing of a moon over a box of bonbons, then puts every section title in a right-hand column behind a hairline spine: eight pieces as staggered tall strips, the four origins in ruled columns on yamabuki, the shop window at night, roast-grind-temper stepping down the page, gift boxes on washi and the journal in three ruled columns. The footer (F1) sets Yoru huge over a yamabuki moon on washi. Origins and Gift boxes pages, journal, newsletter and contact. The shop details, the warm-weather shipping note and the origins table each live in one synced pattern; cacao and origin print under every price (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows a static shelf and orders go by email).

summary.fr: Une boutique calme et sombre pour un petit chocolatier bean-to-bar, avec bonbons, table des origines et note d'expédition estivale.
summary.de: Ein ruhiger, dunkler Shop für einen kleinen Bean-to-Bar-Chocolatier, mit Pralinen, Herkunftstabelle und Sommerversandhinweis.

deviation: 1.1.2 (themes issue #84, user decision 2026-10-15 “English must not be set vertically”): every writing-mode: vertical-rl rule is now scoped to CJK content with :is(:lang(ja), :lang(zh), :lang(ko)); English sites are fully horizontal and the right rail is a stacked list of horizontal items (rail clamp(13.5rem, 7rem + 9vw, 17rem), hairline rules, 01-numerals, current-page dot, scrolls when long); codes unchanged (H11/F1/L5). CSS only, importer and demo content untouched. 1.1.1 (themes issue #80): the right rail now holds only the vertical menu (fluid width, padding and column gaps; long menus wrap into a second tier) and a top band with the wordmark, an Order a box button, account and cart is the header on every width; codes unchanged (H11/F1/L5). 1.1.0 redesign (themes issue #66): archetype tategaki vertical scroll; H3/F1/L11 became H11/F1/L5 (combo unused; neighbours #6 Hogusu H9/F7/L7 and #8 Asagao H5/F10/L12 share no code). Palette slugs kept from 1.0 with new values: tetsukon #17184B pages, yoru night #0F1035 rail and night bands, kinari #F4EFE3 text (14.4:1 on tetsukon), yamabuki #F8B500 accent and band (9.1:1 on tetsukon; tetsukon text on yamabuki 9.1:1), light yamabuki #FFCB45 links, washi #EDE6D3 light sections (tetsukon text 13.3:1), usuzumi #5A5878 quiet text on washi (5.4:1), fuji grey #B9B6CC quiet text on navy (8.4:1). Yamabuki is never used as text on washi (1.45:1); there it marks emphasis as sesame dots. Fonts: Kaisei Decol (Regular, Bold) and BIZ UDPGothic (Regular, Bold) are OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name, subset to Latin WOFF2 in assets/fonts. Illustrations: maki-e lacquer style (gold and yamabuki lacquer on navy) from Grok Build image_gen via scripts/grok-image.sh; the washi texture is a greyscale crop of one generated sheet. 1.0 image names are kept (redrawn in place) so already-imported pages keep working; 1.0 class names keep their styles.
